finding.why_material: EngineAdmission could remain valid after the verified runtime path was atomically replaced before a later loader opened it, allowing route identity to bind bytes that the loader did not consume.
finding.source_scope_note: The retained donor module already stated this loader-binding limitation; this cycle turned it into a discriminating executable falsifier and bounded repair.

unusual_experiment.name: POST_ADMISSION_ATOMIC_PATH_SUBSTITUTION
unusual_experiment.intervention: hash admitted runtime bytes with the retained before/after stat discipline, preserve the resulting admission receipt, atomically replace the same path with different bytes/inode, then simulate the later loader opening that path

laws: pre-load VerifiedEngineAdmission no longer exposes route artifact-registry material by itself
route registry requires a PostLoadArtifactBinding tied to exact generation, engine identity, artifact bundle, pre-load admission receipt and all four artifact digests
checkpoint, tokenizer, runtime and build paths are re-digested after loader return before route registry exposure
stale generation or any post-load byte mismatch fails closed
repair.known_limit: Pre/post path hashing closes straightforward hash-then-load substitution but cannot prove against a malicious swap-and-restore entirely inside the loader window. Whole runtime acceptance still requires a loader-attested consumed-byte identity or an immutable/read-only artifact boundary bound to the loader.

new_cases: route registry rejects missing post-load binding
atomic runtime path substitution after pre-load admission fails post-load revalidation
stale generation at post-load binding fails closed

artefact_readme.reason: Current README already names real checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/build positive engine admission as a frontier. This dependent donor hardening does not change top-level EntityOS/HCU authority or acceptance.

negative_results_and_blocks: no actually-started full EntityOS/HCU isolated executor was exposed to this organ
no real local ~0.8B checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/build bytes were loaded
no real loader attested the bytes it actually consumed
no exact integrated Typed Entry -> EngineAdmission -> real loader -> HCU route -> inference receipt chain was executed
RFC8785 end-to-end causal identity wiring remains a separate current PR1263 gate
next_exact_gate: Fuse the smallest post-load binding into the retained PR1263 lane after its current RFC8785 identity work settles; then bind a real admitted local checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/build plus immutable or loader-attested consumed-byte identity and execute the exact Typed Entry -> EngineAdmission -> load -> post-load binding -> HCU route -> inference receipt chain in an actually-started authorized isolated executor.
